sloka: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम् ।हतानि एकेन रामेण मानुषेण पदातिना ॥३-२६-३५॥
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām ।hatāni ekena rāmeṇa mānuṣeṇa padātinā ॥3-26-35॥

translations.english: Fourteen thousand formidable demons were killed by Rama, a pedestrian human, singlehanded.
